question: A trader sells an article at a profit of 15%. Had he bought it at 10% more and sold it for ₹34 more, he would have earned a profit of 20%. The cost price of the article (in ₹) is:
solution:
**Given : **

Profit = 15% 

10% more and sold it at Rs.34 more 

He would have gained 20%.

**Calculation : **

By applying ratio method,

⇒ 15% = 3/20 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fdf7c5727f4f4bd17e6b64df9712a83f4610d8ecd5c31c97ecf7276d6e58762.png] 

⇒ 26.4 - 23 = 3.4

⇒ 3.4 = 34

⇒ 1 = 10

⇒ CP = 20 × 10 = 200

**∴ The correct answer is 200.**
